verdict.rationale: Netlify's deploy previews per PR and preview environments give each dev an isolated environment automatically (docs-1, docs-19), and CLI/dashboard workflows support many concurrent builds (docs-3, docs-15). However, there's no explicit evidence of unlimited scale guarantees or team-wide concurrency limits, and billing complaints (comm-1, comm-3) suggest cost/scale caveats that could constrain 'unlimited' simultaneous shipping.
